newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open a bit higher after Friday plunge.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open a bit higher after Friday plunge.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened slightly higher on Monday, after tumbling last week.
Buying back of bank shares pulled the market higher but it still lacked confidence in the government's economic policies, brokers said.
The key Nikkei average of 225 leading shares rose 86.65 points, or 0.50 percent, to 17,390.30.
"Since bank shares slightly recovered in late Friday trade, the Nikkei average may post a brief rebound today," said an analyst at a second-tier securities house.
The Nikkei tumbled 770.22 points, or 4.26 percent, to close at 17,303.65 on Friday, its lowest close since August 1995.
